verdict.rationale: Phoenix exposes an official MCP endpoint that lets MCP-compatible AI clients (Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code) 'search, query, and operate on projects, traces, datasets, experiments, prompts, and annotations,' enabling natural-language operation via an external agent, and it also supports agent-driven CLI setup (npx phoenix-cli setup). However, this is mediated entirely through third-party MCP clients rather than a built-in native NL interface, and there's no evidence of a first-party chat/NL command surface within Phoenix itself. missing for 10: native in-product NL command interface, independent hands-on validation of MCP-driven operation.
